integrity: The explicit example is proved using the integral and finite-coefficient Wang sequences, naturality of the Pontryagin square and coefficient Bocksteins, and the cited dimension-six period-index and regular-gerbe realization theorems. Finite checker confirms arithmetic, not those external theorems. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only smooth banded order-two gerbes with constant ineffective stabilizer on connected closed nonorientable five-manifolds. No assertion about mixed trivial and nontrivial stabilizers or higher orders.
title: Sharp rank eight for banded \(\mu_2\)-gerbes over nonorientable five-manifolds
